articles.title: Breaking Down the Ending of Jessica Chastain's Nashville Thriller Heartland
articles.summary: Netflix's Heartland follows Misty Jones ( Jessica Chastain ), a former country music star living in self-imposed exile who returns to Nashville after her niece, an up-and-coming singer named Charlie Heart (Carter Faith), goes missing. articles.title: Inside Salish and Jordan Matter’s Growing Father-Daughter Empire
articles.summary: It’s already 10:27 p.m. on a Saturday night in October when Salish Matter asks gently, “Are we going to start filming soon?” The 16-year-old stands in the aisle of her local Target in Manhattan Beach, Calif., beside her father Jordan Matter. They are dressed almost identically, in jeans and black shirts. articles.title: How Texas’ Blue Takeover Could Soon Begin Impacting Texans’ Lives
articles.summary: Texas has long been led by Republicans, from its governor’s mansion and state legislature down to many of its locally held offices. But this year’s elections have abruptly turned the ruby-red state blue , with sweeping implications for Texas’ laws and the lives of its more than 30 million residents. Democrats scored a series of historic victories in Texas state politics earlier this month, winning every statewide race on the ballot and a number of more local contests to boot. articles.title: What An Early Polar Vortex Combined With El Niño Means For Winter Weather
articles.summary: A record-early breakdown of the polar vortex is expected to bring cold weather to the United States by the end of the month.
